revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Football Plays
revealWordProblem.text:
To make a first down, a football team must gain at least 10 yards from where it started, called the line of scrimmage. During one series of plays a team had a 10-yard loss, a 4-yard gain, a 3-yard loss, and a 21-yard gain.
Question: Did the football team make a first down? How far are they from the line of scrimmage?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A football field marked with the line of scrimmage, the first down line, and the 10-yard gain between them.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Write each play as an integer, with losses negative and gains positive: −10, +4, −3, +21. Add them in order: −10 + 4 = −6, then −6 + (−3) = −9, then −9 + 21 = +12. The team ended 12 yards past the line of scrimmage. Since 12 is at least 10, yes — they made the first down, with 2 yards to spare.

questions.stem: Badwater Basin is 86 meters below sea level, and sea level is 0. Which integer represents that elevation?
questions.explanation: Below sea level means less than 0, so the elevation is written with a negative sign: -86 meters.
choiceFeedback: The digits got reversed here: the sign is right but the distance is not. The sign says 86 meters, not 68.
Zero is sea level itself, the surface of the water — not a spot 86 meters underneath it.
This is 86 meters ABOVE sea level. Dropping the negative sign moves the point to the wrong side of 0.
hints: Sea level is 0. Is 'below sea level' more than 0 or less than 0?
Numbers less than 0 are negative numbers and are written with a − sign in front.
Keep the distance the sign gives you — 86 meters — and add the symbol that shows the point is below 0.
questions.stemEs: Badwater Basin está 86 metros bajo el nivel del mar, y el nivel del mar es 0. ¿Qué entero representa esa elevación?
questions.explanationEs: Bajo el nivel del mar significa menos que 0, así que la elevación se escribe con signo negativo: -86 metros.
hintsEs: El nivel del mar es 0. ¿'Debajo del nivel del mar' es más de 0 o menos de 0?
Los números menores que 0 son números negativos y se escriben con un signo − delante.
Conserva la distancia que da el letrero — 86 metros — y agrega el símbolo que muestra que el punto está debajo del 0.

questions.stem: In Reykjavik the temperature was -9°C. What is the opposite of -9?
questions.explanation: The opposite of a number is the same distance from 0 on the other side, so the opposite of -9 is 9.
choiceFeedback: Doubling the distance from 0 is not the same as crossing to the other side. The opposite keeps the distance 9 and only changes the direction.
A number cannot be its own opposite unless it is 0. The opposite of a negative number is on the other side of 0, so it is positive.
Zero is its own opposite, but it is not the opposite of -9 — it is 9 units away from -9, not on the far side of 0.
hints: 'Opposite' means the same distance from 0, but on the other side of 0.
-9 sits 9 units to the LEFT of 0. Count 9 units to the RIGHT of 0 instead.
Keep the 9 exactly the same and change only the direction, which means changing only the sign.
questions.stemEs: En Reikiavik la temperatura era -9°C. ¿Cuál es el opuesto de -9?
questions.explanationEs: El opuesto de un número está a la misma distancia de 0 pero del otro lado, así que el opuesto de -9 es 9.
hintsEs: 'Opuesto' significa la misma distancia del 0, pero al otro lado del 0.
-9 está a 9 unidades a la IZQUIERDA del 0. Cuenta 9 unidades a la DERECHA del 0 en su lugar.
Conserva el 9 exactamente igual y cambia solo la dirección, lo que significa cambiar solo el signo.

choices: A number written -0, which is less than 0
questions.explanation: Zero is 0 units from itself, so there is no other side to move to. Zero is its own opposite.
choiceFeedback: There is no separate point for -0 on the number line. Writing a negative sign in front of 0 still names the same single point, 0.
The opposite of a number is one specific number, not a whole group of them. Every number has exactly one opposite.
Zero does have an opposite. Since its distance from 0 is 0, it lands right back on itself.
hints: The opposite of a number is the same distance from 0 on the other side.
Ask yourself: how many units away from 0 is 0 itself?
If a number is 0 units from 0, moving to the other side takes you to the very same point.
questions.explanationEs: El cero está a 0 unidades de sí mismo, así que no hay otro lado al que moverse. El cero es su propio opuesto.
hintsEs: El opuesto de un número está a la misma distancia del 0, del otro lado.
Pregúntate: ¿a cuántas unidades del 0 está el 0 mismo?
Si un número está a 0 unidades del 0, moverte al otro lado te lleva al mismísimo punto.

steps: 1. Integers: Positive whole numbers, negative whole numbers, and zero (..., -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, ...)
2. Opposites: Numbers that are the same distance from 0 in opposite directions (e.g. -5 and 5)
3. The opposite of the opposite of a number is the number itself: -(-a) = a
reviewHighlights.watchOut: The most common mistake in this lesson is thinking that the opposite of a negative integer is still negative — for example, saying the opposite of -7 is -7, or that the opposite of -12 is -24. Opposites are the same DISTANCE from 0 but on OPPOSITE sides of 0, so taking an opposite always changes the direction and never changes the distance: the opposite of -7 is 7 and the opposite of -12 is 12. The one exception is 0, which is 0 units from itself and is therefore its own opposite. Before you submit, count the units from 0 and check that your answer is on the other side.

hintsEs: Bajo el suelo significa menos que 0. Usa el signo −.

level2.stem: Leo says the opposite of −11 is −11, because it is the same number. Is he right? What is the opposite of −11?
level2.stemEs: Leo dice que el opuesto de −11 es −11, porque es el mismo número. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuál es el opuesto de −11?
hints: An opposite is on the other side of 0. Which side is −11 on?
hintsEs: Un opuesto está en el otro lado del 0. ¿En qué lado está −11?
level2.explanation: Find the side of −11: −11 → 11 units left of 0 Move to the other side of 0: 11 units right of 0 → 11
level2.explanationEs: Halla el lado de −11: −11 → 11 unidades a la izquierda del 0 Pasa al otro lado del 0: 11 unidades a la derecha del 0 → 11

level2.stem: Find −(−(−(−4))). Each − sign means "the opposite of."
level2.stemEs: Halla −(−(−(−4))). Cada signo − significa "el opuesto de".
hints: Count the − signs. Each one flips the number across 0.
hintsEs: Cuenta los signos −. Cada uno pasa el número al otro lado del 0.
level2.explanation: Count the − signs: 4 signs → 4 flips Flip 4 one step at a time: 4 → −4 → 4 → −4 → 4
level2.explanationEs: Cuenta los signos −: 4 signos → 4 vueltas Da vuelta al 4 paso a paso: 4 → −4 → 4 → −4 → 4

hints: 18 is right of 0. Its opposite is the same distance on the left.

level2.explanationEs: Halla qué tan lejos está 18 del 0: 18 unidades a la derecha del 0 Ve 18 unidades a la izquierda del 0: 18 → −18

hints: What does −(−n) equal? Two flips bring a number back.

level2.explanation: Simplify the two flips: −(−n) = n Use the equation: n = −31
level2.explanationEs: Simplifica las dos vueltas: −(−n) = n Usa la ecuación: n = −31

level2.stem: A store's sales went down by $45 this week. Zero means no change. Write the change in sales as an integer.

hints: Went down means less than no change. Use a − sign.
hintsEs: Bajaron significa menos que ningún cambio. Usa el signo −.
level2.explanation: Decide what 0 means: 0 = no change Write the drop with a − sign: went down $45 → −45
level2.explanationEs: Decide qué significa 0: 0 = ningún cambio Escribe la baja con el signo −: bajaron $45 → −45

level3.stem: Badwater Basin sits 86 meters below sea level, where sea level is defined as 0. Which integer represents this elevation?
choiceFeedback: Zero IS sea level. The basin sits 86 meters beneath it.
The digits are right but the size is off by a factor of ten. The depth is 86 meters.
That places the basin 86 meters ABOVE sea level. Below zero is negative.
level3.explanation: Below sea level means less than zero, so the elevation is −86 meters. Writing 86 would place it 86 meters ABOVE sea level.

level3.stem: Kai says −(−17) is negative because it has a − sign in front. What is −(−17)?
level3.stemEs: Kai dice que −(−17) es negativo porque tiene un signo − adelante. ¿Cuánto es −(−17)?
hints: Read it as "the opposite of −17." Which side of 0 is that on?
hintsEs: Léelo como "el opuesto de −17". ¿En qué lado del 0 está?
level3.explanation: Read the inside first: −17 is left of 0 Flip it across 0: −(−17) = 17
level3.explanationEs: Lee primero lo de adentro: −17 está a la izquierda del 0 Pásalo al otro lado del 0: −(−17) = 17

hints: Count the − signs. An odd number of flips ends on the left of 0.

level3.explanation: Count the − signs: 3 signs → 3 flips Flip 19 three times: 19 → −19 → 19 → −19
level3.explanationEs: Cuenta los signos −: 3 signos → 3 vueltas Da vuelta al 19 tres veces: 19 → −19 → 19 → −19

level3.stem: On a game show, 0 means no points. Ana's score is the opposite of −(−65). What is Ana's score?
level3.stemEs: En un concurso, 0 significa cero puntos. El puntaje de Ana es el opuesto de −(−65). ¿Cuál es el puntaje de Ana?
hints: Find −(−65) first. Then find its opposite.
hintsEs: Primero halla −(−65). Luego halla su opuesto.

level3.stem: Point C is at 2. Point A is 5 units to the left of C. Point B is the opposite of A. What is B?
level3.stemEs: El punto C está en 2. El punto A está 5 unidades a la izquierda de C. El punto B es el opuesto de A. ¿Cuánto es B?
hints: Find A first. Count 5 units left from 2 on a number line.
hintsEs: Primero halla A. Cuenta 5 unidades a la izquierda desde 2 en una recta numérica.
level3.explanation: Count 5 units left from 2: 2 − 5 = −3 Name A: A = −3 Find the opposite of A: B = −(−3) = 3
level3.explanationEs: Cuenta 5 unidades a la izquierda desde 2: 2 − 5 = −3 Nombra A: A = −3 Halla el opuesto de A: B = −(−3) = 3
